sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily, I'm happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Cyprus.
Cyprus is a small, sunny and beautiful island
in the Mediterranean Sea.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Cyprus?
Cyprus is in the eastern Mediterranean.
It is close to Turkey, Greece, Syria and Lebanon.
It is an island country with many beaches, mountains and villages.
What is the capital city of Cyprus?
The capital city is Nicosia.
It is in the middle of the island.
Nicosia is a divided city.
Part is Greek Cypriot and part is Turkish Cypriot.
Other important cities include Limosol, a port and beach city.
Larnaca with an airport and a seaside promenade.
Purinia with a castle and a harbor.
Famagusta, known for its history and ruins.
Pathos, famous for ancient temples and mythology.
How many people live in Cyprus?
About 1.2 million people live in Cyprus.
Most people live in cities or coastal towns.
There are two main communities, Greek Cypriots, Turkish Cypriots.
Both groups have rich culture, music and traditions.
What language do people speak in Cyprus?
People speak Greek in the south, Turkish in the north.
English is also widely spoken, especially in schools, tourism and business.
What is the weather like in Cyprus?
Cyprus has a Mediterranean climate.
This means hot and dry summers, mild and rainy winters.
It is sunny most of the year, perfect for swimming and outdoor life.
What does Cyprus look like?
Cyprus has sandy beaches and blue water.
Mountains, like the Trudos Mountains.
Olive trees, vineyards and pine forests,
ancient ruins, castles and villages on hills.
It is a great place for both nature lovers and history fans.
What animals live in Cyprus?
You can see goats, sheep and donkeys,
foxes, hedgehogs and birds.
Sea turtles, they lay eggs on the beaches,
butterflies, cats and many lizards.
Cats are everywhere.
Cyprus is known as the island of cats.
What do people eat in Cyprus?
Cypriot food is fresh, tasty and shared with others.
People eat bread, cheese, olives and vegetables.
Meat, especially lamb, pork and chicken,
fish and seafood by the coast.
Popular dishes, halloumi,
a salty cheese, grilled or fried.
Khabab, suvlaki, meat on a stick.
Maison, many small plates shared at the table.
Doma, stuffed grape leaves,
baklava, a sweet dessert with honey and nuts.
What do people drink in Cyprus?
People drink water and fresh juice.
Coffee, strong, served in small cups.
Tea, especially with mint.
Wine?
Cyprus makes its own.
Adults may drink zivania or ozo, local spirits.
Coffee shops are important.
People sit and talk for hours.
What is life like in Cyprus?
Life in Cyprus is relaxed, friendly and family-centered.
People enjoy swimming and going to the beach,
walking in nature,
sitting at cafes and talking with friends,
dancing, music and festivals,
cooking and eating together.
What are some holidays and traditions in Cyprus?
Independence Day, October 1st.
Easter, with candles, eggs and big family meals.
Christmas, with sweets and carols,
carnival with costumes and parades,
Bairam and Ramadan in the Turkish Cypriic community.
People celebrate with music, dancing and special food.
Some fun facts about Cyprus.
Cyprus has been lived in for thousands of years.
It is the third largest island in the Mediterranean.
The flag has a map of the island
and olive branches for peace.
The goddess Aphrodite was said to be born in Cyprus.
Driving is on the left side of the road.
Now you know many things about Cyprus.
You know where it is, what people speak
and what they eat.
You learned about the land, culture and daily life.
Well done!
I am Emili.
Goodbye, or as they say in Greek,
Yasso, and in Turkish, Hostakau.
